## File: onboard/vio/ev_bridge.py
````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""ROS vision odometry -> native PX4 external vision, on hardware or ROS /clock.

The capture timestamp stays the measurement timestamp. Middleware owns clock
transport; this node owns frame conversion, validity, source resets and health.
"""
import math

import rclpy
from rclpy.node import Node
from nav_msgs.msg import Odometry
from px4_msgs.msg import VehicleOdometry
from std_msgs.msg import Bool

from .frames import WORLDS,initial_reset_counter,odometry_to_px4,quat_xyzw_to_wxyz
from .ownership import PublisherGuard
from .ros_common import PX4_QOS,SENSOR_QOS,declare,fill_vehicle_odometry,now_us,stamp_of
from .validation import CaptureGate,sample_problem
from .vio_health import VioHealth


class EvBridge(Node):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__('px4_vision_bridge')
        self.world=str(declare(self,'world','flu'))
        if self.world not in WORLDS:raise ValueError('world must be enu or flu')
        heading=float(declare(self,'heading_enu_rad',math.nan))
        reference=str(declare(self,'heading_reference',''))
        self.heading=None if math.isnan(heading) else heading
        if self.heading is not None and (not math.isfinite(heading) or not reference.strip() or self.world!='flu'):
            raise ValueError('heading alignment needs a finite surveyed FLU-to-ENU reference and its description')
        self.required=set(declare(self,'required_fields',['position','orientation']))
        if not self.required or not self.required<={'position','orientation','velocity'}:
            raise ValueError('required_fields must name the position/orientation/velocity fields consumed by PX4')
        self.in_topic=str(declare(self,'odom_topic','/visual_slam/tracking/odometry'))
        self.out_topic=str(declare(self,'out_topic','/fmu/in/vehicle_visual_odometry'))
        self.velocity_in_body=bool(declare(self,'velocity_in_body',True))
        self.quality=int(declare(self,'quality',0))
        self.jump_m=float(declare(self,'jump_reset_m',1.))
        self.health_stale_s=float(declare(self,'health_stale_s',0.5))
        self.max_speed=float(declare(self,'max_speed_mps',5.))
        self.quiet_s=float(declare(self,'health_quiet_s',5.))
        if not all(math.isfinite(v) and v>0 for v in (self.jump_m,self.health_stale_s,self.max_speed,self.quiet_s)):
            raise ValueError('health limits must be positive finite numbers')
        self.gate=CaptureGate(float(declare(self,'max_sample_age_s',.3)),float(declare(self,'future_tol_s',.005)))
        self.health=self._health()
        self.floors={name:[float(v) for v in declare(self,name,[0.,0.,0.])]
                     for name in ('position_floor','orientation_floor','velocity_floor')}
        if any(len(v)!=3 or not all(math.isfinite(x) and x>=0 for x in v) for v in self.floors.values()):
            raise ValueError('variance floors need three finite nonnegative values')
        self.pub=self.create_publisher(VehicleOdometry,self.out_topic,PX4_QOS)
        self.ok_pub=self.create_publisher(Bool,str(declare(self,'health_topic','/estimator/healthy')),10)
        self.guard=PublisherGuard(self,self.out_topic) if self.out_topic.startswith('/fmu/in/') else None
        self.sub=self.create_subscription(Odometry,self.in_topic,self._on_odom,SENSOR_QOS)
        self.reset_counter=initial_reset_counter();self.last_pos=None;self.frame_id=None
        self.last_now=None;self.last_good=None;self.ok=False;self.reason='no samples'
        self.counts={'input':0,'published':0,'invalid':0,'withheld':0,'unowned':0,'clock_resets':0}
        self.create_timer(.2,self._publish_health)
        self.create_timer(5.,self._log)
        self.get_logger().info(f'{self.in_topic} -> {self.out_topic}; frame={self.world}; heading reference={reference or "unreferenced (FRD)"}')

    def _health(self):
        return VioHealth(max_speed_mps=self.max_speed,jump_m=self.jump_m,quiet_s=self.quiet_s)

    def _observe_clock(self,now):
        if self.last_now is not None and now<self.last_now:
            self.gate.reset();self.health=self._health();self.last_pos=None;self.frame_id=None
            self.reset_counter=(self.reset_counter+1)&255;self.last_good=None;self.ok=False
            self.reason='ROS clock restarted';self.counts['clock_resets']+=1
        self.last_now=now

    def _healthy_now(self):
        now=now_us(self);self._observe_clock(now)
        return bool(self.ok and self.last_good is not None and 0<=now-self.last_good<self.health_stale_s*1e6)

    def _publish_health(self):
        self.ok_pub.publish(Bool(data=self._healthy_now()))

    def _on_odom(self,msg):
        self.counts['input']+=1
        now=now_us(self);self._observe_clock(now);capture=stamp_of(msg.header)
        accepted,reason,_=self.gate.check(capture,now)
        if not accepted:
            if reason not in ('duplicate','reordered'):self.ok=False
            self.reason=reason;return
        p,q=msg.pose.pose.position,msg.pose.pose.orientation
        v,w=msg.twist.twist.linear,msg.twist.twist.angular
        pos=(p.x,p.y,p.z);quat=(q.x,q.y,q.z,q.w);vel=(v.x,v.y,v.z)
        problem=sample_problem(self.required,pos,quat,vel)
        if problem:
            self.ok=False;self.reason=problem;self.counts['invalid']+=1;return
        sane,reason=self.health.update(capture*1e-6,pos)
        if self.guard is not None and not self.guard.may_publish():
            self.ok=False;self.reason='proving sole vision ownership';self.counts['unowned']+=1;return
        self.ok,self.reason=sane,reason
        if not sane:self.counts['withheld']+=1;return
        changed=(self.frame_id is not None and self.frame_id!=msg.header.frame_id)
        jumped=self.last_pos is not None and math.dist(self.last_pos,pos)>self.jump_m
        if changed or jumped:self.reset_counter=(self.reset_counter+1)&255
        self.frame_id=msg.header.frame_id;self.last_pos=pos
        norm=math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in quat));quat=tuple(x/norm for x in quat) if norm>0 else quat
        value=odometry_to_px4(stamp_sample_us=capture,now_us=now,position=pos,
            q_wxyz=quat_xyzw_to_wxyz(*quat),world=self.world,heading_enu_rad=self.heading,
            velocity=vel,velocity_in_body=self.velocity_in_body,angular_velocity=(w.x,w.y,w.z),
            pose_cov=list(msg.pose.covariance),twist_cov=list(msg.twist.covariance),
            reset_counter=self.reset_counter,quality=self.quality,**self.floors)
        self.pub.publish(fill_vehicle_odometry(VehicleOdometry(),value))
        self.last_good=now;self.counts['published']+=1

    def _log(self):
        self.get_logger().info(f'counts={self.counts} captures={self.gate.counts} healthy={self._healthy_now()} reason={self.reason}')

    def destroy_node(self):
        guard=getattr(self,'guard',None)
        if guard is not None:guard.close()
        return super().destroy_node()


def main(args=None):
    rclpy.init(args=args);node=None
    try:
        node=EvBridge();rclpy.spin(node)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:pass
    finally:
        if node is not None:node.destroy_node()
        rclpy.shutdown()


if __name__=='__main__':main()
````

## File: onboard/vio/frames.py
````python
"""Frame math for feeding PX4 external-vision odometry from ROS sources. PURE.

ROS (REP-103/105): world ENU, or an arbitrary-heading x-forward / y-left /
z-up map such as cuVSLAM's start frame; body FLU; Odometry twist in the
child (body) frame by default.
PX4 VehicleOdometry: world NED (pose_frame 1) or FRD-world (pose_frame 2:
x-forward at init, constant unknown heading offset from north); body FRD.

Quaternions are (w, x, y, z) in this module. ROS messages carry (x, y, z, w);
convert at the edge with quat_xyzw_to_wxyz(). Attitude quaternions rotate
BODY vectors into the WORLD frame, in both conventions.

No ROS imports: this runs and is unit-tested on any Python.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math

NAN = float("nan")

POSE_FRAME_NED = 1
POSE_FRAME_FRD = 2
VELOCITY_FRAME_NED = 1
VELOCITY_FRAME_FRD = 2
VELOCITY_FRAME_BODY_FRD = 3

WORLD_ENU = "enu"   # north-aligned ROS world
WORLD_FLU = "flu"   # arbitrary-heading x-forward/y-left/z-up map (cuVSLAM, most VIO)
WORLDS = (WORLD_ENU, WORLD_FLU)

_S = math.sqrt(0.5)
# rotation taking ENU-expressed vectors to NED-expressed vectors (180 deg about (1,1,0)/sqrt2)
Q_ENU_TO_NED = (0.0, _S, _S, 0.0)
# 180 deg about x: FLU<->FRD for a body, and x-fwd/y-left/z-up <-> FRD for a world
Q_X180 = (0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- quaternions
def qmul(a, b):
    w1, x1, y1, z1 = a
    w2, x2, y2, z2 = b
    return (w1 * w2 - x1 * x2 - y1 * y2 - z1 * z2,
            w1 * x2 + x1 * w2 + y1 * z2 - z1 * y2,
            w1 * y2 - x1 * z2 + y1 * w2 + z1 * x2,
            w1 * z2 + x1 * y2 - y1 * x2 + z1 * w2)


def qconj(q):
    w, x, y, z = q
    return (w, -x, -y, -z)


def qnormalize(q):
    """Unit quaternion with w >= 0; (nan, nan, nan, nan) when not finite / zero."""
    if not all(math.isfinite(c) for c in q):
        return (NAN, NAN, NAN, NAN)
    n = math.sqrt(sum(c * c for c in q))
    if n < 1e-12:
        return (NAN, NAN, NAN, NAN)
    w, x, y, z = (c / n for c in q)
    if w < 0.0:
        w, x, y, z = -w, -x, -y, -z
    return (w, x, y, z)


def qrotate(q, v):
    """Rotate vector v by unit quaternion q (q * v * q^-1)."""
    w, x, y, z = q
    vx, vy, vz = v
    # t = 2 * cross(q.xyz, v)
    tx = 2.0 * (y * vz - z * vy)
    ty = 2.0 * (z * vx - x * vz)
    tz = 2.0 * (x * vy - y * vx)
    # v' = v + w*t + cross(q.xyz, t)
    return (vx + w * tx + (y * tz - z * ty),
            vy + w * ty + (z * tx - x * tz),
            vz + w * tz + (x * ty - y * tx))


def quat_xyzw_to_wxyz(x, y, z, w):
    return (float(w), float(x), float(y), float(z))


def quat_from_yaw(yaw):
    """Rotation about +z by yaw (radians)."""
    return (math.cos(0.5 * yaw), 0.0, 0.0, math.sin(0.5 * yaw))


def yaw_of(q):
    """ZYX yaw (rad) of a (w,x,y,z) quaternion."""
    w, x, y, z = q
    return math.atan2(2.0 * (w * z + x * y), 1.0 - 2.0 * (y * y + z * z))


def tilt_of(q):
    """Angle (rad) between the body z axis and the world z axis."""
    bz = qrotate(q, (0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    c = max(-1.0, min(1.0, bz[2]))
    return math.acos(c)


# ------------------------------------------------------------ frame mapping
def _check_world(world):
    if world not in WORLDS:
        raise ValueError(f"world must be one of {WORLDS}, got {world!r}")


def world_vec(v, world):
    """World-frame vector from ROS convention to the matching PX4 world frame.
    enu -> NED: (n, e, d) = (y, x, -z).  flu-map -> FRD-world: (x, -y, -z)."""
    _check_world(world)
    x, y, z = (float(c) for c in v)
    if world == WORLD_ENU:
        return (y, x, -z)
    return (x, -y, -z)


def body_vec(v):
    """Body vector FLU -> FRD."""
    x, y, z = (float(c) for c in v)
    return (x, -y, -z)


def pose_frame_for(world):
    _check_world(world)
    return POSE_FRAME_NED if world == WORLD_ENU else POSE_FRAME_FRD


def velocity_frame_for(world, in_body):
    if in_body:
        return VELOCITY_FRAME_BODY_FRD
    _check_world(world)
    return VELOCITY_FRAME_NED if world == WORLD_ENU else VELOCITY_FRAME_FRD


def attitude_to_px4(q_wxyz, world):
    """Body-FLU->ROS-world attitude  ->  body-FRD->PX4-world attitude.
    q_px4 = q_W (x) q_ros (x) q_B with q_B: FRD->FLU (x180), q_W: ROS world -> PX4 world."""
    _check_world(world)
    q = qnormalize(tuple(float(c) for c in q_wxyz))
    if not math.isfinite(q[0]):
        return (NAN, NAN, NAN, NAN)
    q_w = Q_ENU_TO_NED if world == WORLD_ENU else Q_X180
    return qnormalize(qmul(qmul(q_w, q), Q_X180))


def attitude_from_px4(q_px4_wxyz, world):
    """Inverse of attitude_to_px4 (for estimated-state consumers and round-trip tests)."""
    _check_world(world)
    q_w = Q_ENU_TO_NED if world == WORLD_ENU else Q_X180
    q = qnormalize(tuple(float(c) for c in q_px4_wxyz))
    if not math.isfinite(q[0]):
        return (NAN, NAN, NAN, NAN)
    return qnormalize(qmul(qmul(qconj(q_w), q), qconj(Q_X180)))


# --------------------------------------------------------------- covariance
def _diag(cov, i):
    """Diagonal element i of a row-major 6x6 covariance; 0.0 when absent."""
    if cov is None:
        return 0.0
    try:
        v = float(cov[i * 6 + i])
    except (IndexError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0.0
    return v if math.isfinite(v) and v >= 0.0 else 0.0


def position_variance(pose_cov, world):
    """Diagonal of the ROS pose covariance mapped to the PX4 world axis order."""
    _check_world(world)
    vx, vy, vz = _diag(pose_cov, 0), _diag(pose_cov, 1), _diag(pose_cov, 2)
    return (vy, vx, vz) if world == WORLD_ENU else (vx, vy, vz)


def orientation_variance(pose_cov):
    """Roll/pitch/yaw variances; axis sign flips do not change a variance."""
    return (_diag(pose_cov, 3), _diag(pose_cov, 4), _diag(pose_cov, 5))


def velocity_variance(twist_cov, world, in_body):
    vx, vy, vz = _diag(twist_cov, 0), _diag(twist_cov, 1), _diag(twist_cov, 2)
    if in_body or world == WORLD_FLU:
        return (vx, vy, vz)
    return (vy, vx, vz)


def apply_floor(var, floor):
    return tuple(max(float(a), float(b)) for a, b in zip(var, floor))


# -------------------------------------------------------------- timestamps
def stamp_us(sec, nanosec):
    """ROS builtin_interfaces/Time -> integer microseconds."""
    return int(sec) * 1_000_000 + int(nanosec) // 1000


def finite3(v):
    return v is not None and len(v) == 3 and all(math.isfinite(float(c)) for c in v)


# ------------------------------------------------------------ the message
@dataclass
class PX4Odometry:
    """Field-for-field image of px4_msgs/VehicleOdometry (no ROS types)."""
    timestamp: int
    timestamp_sample: int
    pose_frame: int
    position: tuple
    q: tuple
    velocity_frame: int
    velocity: tuple
    angular_velocity: tuple
    position_variance: tuple
    orientation_variance: tuple
    velocity_variance: tuple
    reset_counter: int = 0
    quality: int = 0

    def as_dict(self):
        return {k: (list(v) if isinstance(v, tuple) else v) for k, v in self.__dict__.items()}


def align_to_enu(position, q_wxyz, velocity, pose_cov, twist_cov, world, in_body, heading):
    """Apply a declared heading calibration; never infer north from simulator pose."""
    if world != WORLD_FLU or not math.isfinite(heading):
        raise ValueError("a finite heading reference applies only to a startup-local FLU frame")
    c, s = math.cos(heading), math.sin(heading)

    def vector(v):
        if v is None:
            return None
        x, y, z = v
        return (c*x-s*y, s*x+c*y, z)

    def covariance(values, *, euler_pose=False):
        if values is None:
            return None
        if len(values) != 36:
            raise ValueError("pose/twist covariance needs 36 elements")
        # Euler pose: fixed world yaw adds to yaw; roll/pitch coordinates
        # remain unchanged. Twist angular rates are vectors and DO rotate.
        # Preserve full cross terms before selecting PX4's diagonal.
        r = ((c,-s,0.), (s,c,0.), (0.,0.,1.))
        a = [[(float(i == j) if euler_pose and i >= 3 else r[i%3][j%3])
              if i//3 == j//3 else 0. for j in range(6)] for i in range(6)]
        return [sum(a[i][k]*values[k*6+l]*a[j][l] for k in range(6) for l in range(6)
                    if a[i][k] and a[j][l]) for i in range(6) for j in range(6)]

    yaw = (math.cos(heading/2), 0., 0., math.sin(heading/2))
    return (vector(position), qmul(yaw, q_wxyz), velocity if in_body else vector(velocity),
            covariance(pose_cov, euler_pose=True), twist_cov if in_body else covariance(twist_cov))


def odometry_to_px4(*, stamp_sample_us, now_us, position, q_wxyz, world,
                    velocity=None, velocity_in_body=True, angular_velocity=None,
                    pose_cov=None, twist_cov=None, reset_counter=0, quality=0,
                    position_floor=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), orientation_floor=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                    velocity_floor=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), heading_enu_rad=None):
    """Convert one ROS-convention odometry sample into a PX4Odometry.

    position / q_wxyz: ROS world pose (world = 'enu' or 'flu').
    velocity: body FLU linear velocity (velocity_in_body=True, the REP-105
      Odometry default) or ROS-world velocity (False). None -> NaN (unknown).
    angular_velocity: body FLU rates. None -> NaN.
    pose_cov / twist_cov: row-major 6x6 or None. Missing -> 0 (PX4 then uses
      its EKF2_EV*_NOISE lower bounds); floors are applied after mapping.
    heading_enu_rad: surveyed heading of the source origin in ENU. An unknown
      startup heading remains FRD; a finite reference rotates pose and covariance.
    """
    _check_world(world)
    if heading_enu_rad is not None:
        position, q_wxyz, velocity, pose_cov, twist_cov = align_to_enu(
            position, q_wxyz, velocity, pose_cov, twist_cov, world, velocity_in_body, heading_enu_rad)
        world = WORLD_ENU
    pos = world_vec(position, world) if finite3(position) else (NAN, NAN, NAN)
    q = attitude_to_px4(q_wxyz, world)
    if finite3(velocity):
        vel = body_vec(velocity) if velocity_in_body else world_vec(velocity, world)
        vel_frame = velocity_frame_for(world, velocity_in_body)
    else:
        vel, vel_frame = (NAN, NAN, NAN), velocity_frame_for(world, velocity_in_body)
    ang = body_vec(angular_velocity) if finite3(angular_velocity) else (NAN, NAN, NAN)
    return PX4Odometry(
        timestamp=int(now_us),
        timestamp_sample=int(stamp_sample_us),
        pose_frame=pose_frame_for(world),
        position=pos,
        q=q,
        velocity_frame=vel_frame,
        velocity=vel,
        angular_velocity=ang,
        position_variance=apply_floor(position_variance(pose_cov, world), position_floor),
        orientation_variance=apply_floor(orientation_variance(pose_cov), orientation_floor),
        velocity_variance=apply_floor(velocity_variance(twist_cov, world, velocity_in_body),
                                      velocity_floor),
        reset_counter=int(reset_counter) & 0xFF,
        quality=int(quality),
    )


def initial_reset_counter(pid=None, now_s=None):
    """A non-zero initial reset generation for a newly started vision source."""
    import os
    import time
    pid = os.getpid() if pid is None else pid
    now_s = time.time() if now_s is None else now_s
    return 1 + (int(pid) * 7 + int(now_s)) % 254
````

## File: onboard/vio/ownership.py
````python
"""One local vision publisher, plus a bounded DDS authority discovery window."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import tempfile
import time


class PublisherGuard:
    def __init__(self,node,topic,window_s=25.0):
        self.node,self.topic=node,topic
        self.window_s=max(25.,float(window_s));self.started=time.monotonic()
        self.counts=[];self.ready=False
        tag=hashlib.sha256((os.environ.get('ROS_DOMAIN_ID','0')+':'+topic).encode()).hexdigest()[:20]
        path=Path(tempfile.gettempdir())/f'px4-vision-{os.getuid()}-{tag}.lock'
        fd=os.open(path,os.O_CREAT|os.O_RDWR|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC,0o600)
        self.stream=os.fdopen(fd,'r+')
        info=os.fstat(fd)
        if info.st_uid!=os.getuid() or not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_nlink!=1 or info.st_mode&0o077:
            self.close();raise ValueError('vision ownership file is not private and regular')
        try:fcntl.flock(fd,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError:
            self.close();raise ValueError('another local process owns this vision input') from None

    def may_publish(self):
        if self.ready:return True
        try:count=self.node.count_publishers(self.topic)
        except Exception:count=None
        self.counts.append(count)
        if time.monotonic()-self.started<self.window_s:return False
        if not self.counts or any(c is None for c in self.counts) or max(self.counts)!=1:
            raise RuntimeError('cannot prove sole vision publisher during the 25-second discovery window')
        self.ready=True
        return True

    def close(self):
        if self.stream is not None:
            self.stream.close();self.stream=None
````

## File: onboard/vio/ros_common.py
````python
"""Shared ROS 2 plumbing for the onboard nodes (QoS that matches PX4's
uXRCE-DDS endpoints, message filling, clock). Everything that can be pure is
NOT here — see frames.py / validation.py."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

from rclpy.qos import (DurabilityPolicy, HistoryPolicy, QoSProfile, ReliabilityPolicy,
                       qos_profile_sensor_data)

# QoS compatible with the pinned native PX4 interface. Validate compatibility
# against the installed endpoints when changing firmware or middleware.
PX4_QOS = QoSProfile(reliability=ReliabilityPolicy.BEST_EFFORT,
                     durability=DurabilityPolicy.TRANSIENT_LOCAL,
                     history=HistoryPolicy.KEEP_LAST, depth=1)

# For simulator / VIO topics: a BEST_EFFORT subscriber matches reliable and
# best-effort publishers alike.
SENSOR_QOS = qos_profile_sensor_data


def now_us(node):
    """Node clock in integer microseconds (honours use_sim_time)."""
    return node.get_clock().now().nanoseconds // 1000


def stamp_of(header):
    from .frames import stamp_us
    return stamp_us(header.stamp.sec, header.stamp.nanosec)


def _f3(v):
    return [float(c) for c in v]


def fill_vehicle_odometry(msg, odo):
    """Copy a frames.PX4Odometry into a px4_msgs/VehicleOdometry message."""
    msg.timestamp = int(odo.timestamp)
    msg.timestamp_sample = int(odo.timestamp_sample)
    msg.pose_frame = int(odo.pose_frame)
    msg.position = _f3(odo.position)
    msg.q = [float(c) for c in odo.q]
    msg.velocity_frame = int(odo.velocity_frame)
    msg.velocity = _f3(odo.velocity)
    msg.angular_velocity = _f3(odo.angular_velocity)
    msg.position_variance = _f3(odo.position_variance)
    msg.orientation_variance = _f3(odo.orientation_variance)
    msg.velocity_variance = _f3(odo.velocity_variance)
    msg.reset_counter = int(odo.reset_counter) & 0xFF
    msg.quality = int(max(-128, min(127, odo.quality)))
    return msg


def declare(node, name, default):
    """Declare + read a parameter. Numeric parameters are dynamically typed so
    `-p duration_s:=150` and `:=150.0` both work (rclpy otherwise refuses an
    INTEGER for a DOUBLE default and the node dies at startup)."""
    from rcl_interfaces.msg import ParameterDescriptor
    dyn = isinstance(default, (int, float)) and not isinstance(default, bool)
    node.declare_parameter(name, default, ParameterDescriptor(dynamic_typing=dyn))
    v = node.get_parameter(name).value
    if isinstance(default, float) and isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool):
        v = float(v)
    return v


def finite_or_nan(x):
    try:
        x = float(x)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return math.nan
    return x if math.isfinite(x) else math.nan
````

## File: onboard/vio/validation.py
````python
"""Measurement validation shared by onboard consumers; no simulator dependencies."""
import math


class CaptureGate:
    """Validate captures on the caller's ROS clock, preserving original sample time."""
    def __init__(self, max_age_s=0.3, future_tol_s=0.005):
        if not all(math.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in (max_age_s, future_tol_s)):
            raise ValueError("capture age/skew limits must be finite and nonnegative")
        self.max_age_us=max_age_s*1e6;self.future_tol_us=future_tol_s*1e6
        self.counts={k:0 for k in ('ok','duplicate','reordered','stale','future','invalid')}
        self.last_us=None

    def reset(self):
        self.last_us=None

    def check(self, capture_us, now_us):
        if (capture_us is None or now_us is None or
                not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (capture_us,now_us)) or capture_us <= 0):
            kind='invalid'
        elif self.last_us is not None and capture_us==self.last_us:kind='duplicate'
        elif self.last_us is not None and capture_us<self.last_us:kind='reordered'
        elif now_us-capture_us>self.max_age_us:kind='stale'
        elif capture_us-now_us>self.future_tol_us:kind='future'
        else:kind='ok'
        self.counts[kind]+=1
        age=None if kind=='invalid' else (now_us-capture_us)*1e-6
        if kind=='ok':self.last_us=capture_us
        return kind=='ok',kind,age


def sample_problem(required, position, quaternion, velocity):
    """Return a reason when any field the target estimator consumes is invalid."""
    if 'position' in required and not all(math.isfinite(float(v)) for v in position):
        return 'non-finite position'
    if 'orientation' in required:
        if not all(math.isfinite(float(v)) for v in quaternion):return 'non-finite orientation'
        norm=math.sqrt(sum(float(v)**2 for v in quaternion))
        if not 0.9<=norm<=1.1:return 'invalid quaternion norm'
    if 'velocity' in required and not all(math.isfinite(float(v)) for v in velocity):
        return 'non-finite velocity'
    return None
````

## File: onboard/vio/vio_health.py
````python
"""Reject impossible VIO kinematics and require a quiet recovery interval."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections import deque


class VioHealth:
    def __init__(self, *, max_speed_mps=5.0, jump_m=1.0, window_s=10.0, max_jumps=1, quiet_s=5.0):
        self.max_speed = float(max_speed_mps)
        self.jump_m = float(jump_m)
        self.window_s = float(window_s)
        self.max_jumps = int(max_jumps)
        self.quiet_s = float(quiet_s)
        self._last = None               # (t, pos) of the last FINITE, advancing sample
        self._events = deque()          # times of insane samples
        self._last_bad_t = None
        self.reason = "no samples"
        self.n_bad = 0

    def update(self, t, pos):
        """-> (ok, reason). t in seconds (measurement time), pos a 3-tuple in any consistent frame."""
        bad = None
        finite = math.isfinite(t) and all(math.isfinite(float(c)) for c in pos)
        if not finite:
            bad = "non-finite sample"
        elif self._last is not None:
            t0, p0 = self._last
            dt = t - t0
            d = math.dist(p0, pos)
            if dt <= 0:
                bad = "measurement time did not advance" + (f" (moved {d:.2f} m)" if d > 0 else "")
            elif d > self.jump_m:
                bad = f"jump {d:.2f} m"
            elif d / dt > self.max_speed:
                bad = f"speed {d / dt:.1f} m/s"
        if finite and (self._last is None or t > self._last[0]):
            self._last = (t, tuple(float(c) for c in pos))
        tb = t if math.isfinite(t) else (self._last[0] if self._last else 0.0)
        if bad:
            self.n_bad += 1
            self._last_bad_t = tb
            self._events.append(tb)
        while self._events and tb - self._events[0] > self.window_s:
            self._events.popleft()
        if len(self._events) > self.max_jumps:
            self.reason = f"{len(self._events)} insane samples in {self.window_s:.0f} s (last: {bad or 'earlier'})"
            return False, self.reason
        if self._last_bad_t is not None and tb - self._last_bad_t < self.quiet_s:
            self.reason = f"settling after '{bad or 'insane sample'}' ({tb - self._last_bad_t:.1f}/{self.quiet_s:.0f} s quiet)"
            return False, self.reason
        self.reason = "ok"
        return True, self.reason
````

## File: onboard/README.md
````markdown
# Your onboard software

## October29 native application check

The identical `onboard/examples/takeoff_land.py` now has local isolated-companion
acceptance: VIO off safely refuses twice; actual cuVSLAM/EV services on complete
takeoff, hover, AUTO_LAND and confirmed disarm. The native flight grade passes,
but sustained timing fails (moving RTF 0.53). An earlier failed fixture is retained.
This is source/interface evidence, not an ARM binary, browser/cloud deployment
or initialized-inertial qualification. No physical aircraft was tested.


## October27 SDK calibration correction

The tracker rig is the body frame. Camera and IMU extrinsics are transformed
together from the recorded physical TF; returned odometry is already the body
pose. No post-hoc camera-frame conjugation is applied. SDK uncertainty is
xyz/Euler-rpy, and invalid covariance withholds the pose while still acknowledging
the capture. Runtime deployment supplies the actual simulated IMU cadence
(480 Hz on the240 Hz preset); hardware defaults remain500 Hz. See
[the correction report](../docs/IMU_FUSION_FIXES_2026-10-27.md).


These files are the actual source executed inside your Linux companion. The
installed NVIDIA cuVSLAM library is a dependency; the tracker ROS wrapper,
odometry conversion/health gates and process launch are all yours to edit.
Physics, PX4 SITL, virtual sensors and the simulation transport stay outside.

```bash
# Inspect normal Linux processes and native device topics.
ps -ef
ros2 topic echo /fmu/out/vehicle_status_v1 --once

# These commands run the source in THIS project. Startup never arms.
python3 onboard/services.py status
python3 onboard/services.py stop
python3 onboard/services.py start
```

The visible process list is `onboard/config/services.json`. Each process has its
own log, PID/start identity, exact command and source receipt under `.onboard/`.
Edit source/config, stop, then start to apply changes. A running Python process
is not automatically replaced when you save a file. Start refuses a second
launch; stop targets this launch's recorded ownership, never process names.

The simulator initially starts this project bringup for convenience. You can
stop it or replace it. A maze needs a working position estimator before PX4
can fly in position-controlled Offboard mode. Stopped/failed vision is reported
unhealthy; no hidden estimator takes over. Outdoor GNSS uses the visible PX4
health/odometry nodes without cuVSLAM.

`/etc/flyx/onboard.json` and `onboard.yaml` contain readable deployment data:
standard ROS clock selection, camera IMU rate and the declared heading reference.
Hardware uses the ROS system clock; simulation selects `use_sim_time: true` and
the standard `/clock` topic. This application imports no simulator clock,
latency model or grader. The managed transport maps clocks and models transport
delay; it does not estimate position, convert frames or make flight decisions.
Camera images, calibration, IMU and `/fmu/*` use their actual ROS message types.

`vio/ev_bridge.py`, `frames.py`, `validation.py`, `vio_health.py` and
`ownership.py` are ordinary onboard integration and safety code. With an unknown
startup heading, vision output is FRD. NED output requires `heading_enu_rad` and
a nonempty `heading_reference`; the code rotates position, orientation and
covariance using that reference. A real deployment needs its own valid surveyed
or otherwise established reference. The maze configuration declares its fixed
start pad; changing that fixture requires changing the calibration too.

The tracker publishes `/visual_slam/processing_status` as standard ROS
`diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticArray`, including frames that produced no pose or
failed. This is useful onboard processing evidence; the simulator observes it
for lockstep without adding simulator calls to the application.

Start the same visible ROS modules directly when configuring your own robot:

```bash
python3 -m onboard.slam.cuvslam_lib_node --ros-args --params-file onboard/config/vio.yaml
python3 -m onboard.vio.ev_bridge --ros-args --params-file onboard/config/vision_bridge.yaml
```

Configure and run them in separate terminals or use the owned bringup above.
Keep the reviewed cuVSLAM/PX4 message versions and actual camera calibration.
The simulator's FC parameter presets are not hardware installation instructions.
This portable package changes frame/transport contracts and needs fresh moving
acceptance; older image flight results do not qualify this revision.

For a raw ROS program based on the supplied takeoff/hover/land example:

```bash
python3 onboard/examples/takeoff_land.py
```

That script directly creates native PX4 publishers/subscribers. It makes no lab
API calls and imports no mission controller. It requests Offboard and arms a
vehicle: run only with the required operator authorization and an appropriate
isolated simulator or reviewed aircraft setup. Its default height is1m.
It resolves native output topic versions from installed `px4_msgs` (`_v1` for
position/status on this image). Compared with the supplied example, stale
telemetry also stops landing retries, takeover yields before another setpoint,
completion requires fresh landed plus disarmed reports, and the process exits
when finished. These decisions are all visible in this script. The October29 direct-companion test exercised this native path; its flight
passed and its overall timing acceptance failed. Managed Run/browser/cloud and
hardware acceptance are separate.

The Micro XRCE agent equivalent is already running on the simulator side. Do not
start another agent or fake `/dev/ttyTHS1` in this container. On hardware the
agent uses the reviewed serial/UDP transport; this project uses the resulting
native ROS interface in either deployment.

The portal Run button remains an optional snapshot/recorded execution path.
Your terminal can run ordinary ROS code directly; direct programs are not
automatically admitted as a managed Run or guaranteed a mission rosbag.
PX4 ULogs and an explicit recorder remain the evidence sources in that case.

## Moving this application to a Jetson

Keep the flight Python file unchanged. Use ROS timers for flight intervals and
normal ROS deployment files for clock selection. Plain Python execution reads
`/etc/flyx/mission.yaml` (or `DRONE_PARAMS_FILE`); absent configuration uses the
standard ROS system clock. An explicitly missing configuration is an error.

On the drone, install the actual OAK ROS driver, measured CameraInfo/TF and
camera/IMU calibration, a compatible ARM ROS/CUDA/cuVSLAM build, matching
`px4_msgs`, and one reviewed uXRCE agent for the FC link. The simulator supplies
virtual devices behind those interfaces. It does not require a different mission
API, a fake serial device or a second agent inside your application container.

The current simulator library image is x86-64/Jazzy/SM120. Its binary cannot be
copied onto an ARM Orin; a matching target build and hardware commissioning are
still required. FlyX's existing aircraft Isaac ROS SLAM container and this
PyCuVSLAM wrapper are related implementations, not identical installed binaries.
Docker provides dependency/process isolation; it does not remove architecture,
driver, calibration or performance differences.

Vision publishes ordinary odometry. The visible EV bridge validates frames,
covariance, reset/freshness and health, then sends `VehicleOdometry` to
`/fmu/in/vehicle_visual_odometry`. This is external visual odometry, not optical
flow. PX4 still estimates state and controls the motors. Without GNSS or another
horizontal estimator, the position-controlled example refuses to arm; forcing
an attitude-only launch to produce drift would be a different program/test.

Real startup heading/frame calibration and PX4 fusion/motor/airframe parameters
need their own reviewed commissioning. Never copy a simulator parameter preset
onto a flight controller as installation instructions. RC safety and operator
arming authorization remain required on hardware.
````

## File: onboard/services.py
````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Start, inspect and stop YOUR onboard ROS processes. Never arms or flies.

    python3 onboard/services.py start
    python3 onboard/services.py status
    python3 onboard/services.py stop

The process list is ordinary editable JSON. PID identity, source receipts and
logs are under .onboard/. No cloud API, Docker socket or simulator source is used.
"""
import argparse
import contextlib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import secrets
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time

SCHEMA = "flyx-onboard-processes/1"


def project_root(value=None):
    root = Path(value or Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent).absolute()
    if root.is_symlink() or not (root / "onboard/config/services.json").is_file():
        raise ValueError("select a project containing onboard/config/services.json")
    return root.resolve()


def source_hashes(root):
    result = {}
    for p in sorted((root / "onboard").rglob("*")):
        if "__pycache__" in p.parts:
            continue
        if p.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("onboard source must contain regular files, not symlinks")
        if p.is_file():
            result[str(p.relative_to(root))] = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if not result:
        raise ValueError("onboard source is missing")
    return result


def starttime(pid):
    try:
        fields = Path(f"/proc/{int(pid)}/stat").read_text().split(") ", 1)[1].split()
        return None if fields[0] == "Z" else int(fields[19])
    except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError):
        return None


def atomic(path, value):
    fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".onboard-", dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as stream:
            json.dump(value, stream, indent=2)
            stream.write("\n"); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.chmod(name, 0o600)
        os.replace(name, path)
        directory = os.open(path.parent, os.O_DIRECTORY)
        try:
            os.fsync(directory)
        finally:
            os.close(directory)
    finally:
        Path(name).unlink(missing_ok=True)


@contextlib.contextmanager
def registry(root):
    folder = root / ".onboard"
    if folder.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("onboard state must not be a symlink")
    folder.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
    lock = folder / "lock"
    if lock.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("onboard lock must not be a symlink")
    with lock.open("a+") as stream:
        fcntl.flock(stream, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        state = folder / "state.json"
        if state.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("onboard registry must not be a symlink")
        value = json.loads(state.read_text()) if state.exists() else None
        if value is not None and (value.get("schema") != SCHEMA or value.get("project") != str(root)
                                  or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", value.get("token", ""))):
            raise ValueError("onboard registry identity is invalid; inspect it before recovery")
        yield folder, state, value


def owned(record):
    """All descendants carrying this launch's random token, never process names."""
    marker = ("FLYX_ONBOARD_TOKEN=" + record["token"]).encode()
    result = {}
    for directory in Path("/proc").iterdir():
        if not directory.name.isdigit() or int(directory.name) == os.getpid():
            continue
        try:
            if directory.stat().st_uid != os.getuid():
                continue
            if marker not in (directory / "environ").read_bytes().split(b"\0"):
                continue
            pid = int(directory.name); stamp = starttime(pid)
            if stamp is not None:
                result[pid] = stamp
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
    return result


def view(root, record):
    if record is None:
        return {"state": "stopped", "processes": [], "project": str(root)}
    alive = owned(record)
    processes = [dict(p, alive=alive.get(p["pid"]) == p["start"]) for p in record.get("processes", [])]
    live = bool(processes) and all(p["alive"] for p in processes)
    return {**record, "state": "running" if live else "incomplete" if alive else "stopped",
            "processes": processes, "owned_pids": sorted(alive),
            "source_matches": source_hashes(root) == record["sources"]}


def status(root):
    with registry(root) as (_, _, record):
        return view(root, record)


def stop_owned(record, grace_s=5.0):
    for sig, wait in ((signal.SIGTERM, grace_s), (signal.SIGKILL, 2.0)):
        for pid, stamp in owned(record).items():
            if starttime(pid) == stamp:
                with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
                    os.kill(pid, sig)
        until = time.monotonic() + wait
        while owned(record) and time.monotonic() < until:
            time.sleep(0.05)
        if not owned(record):
            return
    raise RuntimeError("onboard processes survived termination; ownership remains recorded")


def stop(root, token=None):
    with registry(root) as (_, path, record):
        if record is None:
            return {"state": "stopped", "project": str(root), "processes": []}
        if token is not None and record["token"] != token:
            raise ValueError("another onboard launch owns these processes; left untouched")
        stop_owned(record)
        record["ended_at"] = time.time(); atomic(path, record)
        atomic(path.parent / record["token"] / "launch.json", record)
        return view(root, record)


def plan(root, mode, deployment=None):
    config = json.loads((root / "onboard/config/services.json").read_text())
    if config.get("schema") != "flyx-onboard-services/1" or mode not in config.get("profiles", {}):
        raise ValueError("select a declared onboard service profile")
    rows = []
    for item in config["profiles"][mode]:
        name, argv = item.get("name", ""), item.get("argv")
        if (not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,40}", name) or not isinstance(argv, list)
                or not argv or any(not isinstance(a, str) or "\0" in a for a in argv)):
            raise ValueError("service needs a name and ordinary argv list")
        argv = [a.replace("{project}", str(root)) for a in argv]
        if deployment is not None:
            argv += ["--params-file", str(deployment)]
        rows.append({"name": name, "argv": argv})
    if not rows or len({r["name"] for r in rows}) != len(rows):
        raise ValueError("service names must be nonempty and unique")
    return rows


def start(root, mode="vio", deployment=None, token=None, world_token=None):
    if deployment is not None:
        deployment = Path(deployment).resolve(strict=True)
    rows = plan(root, mode, deployment)
    with registry(root) as (folder, path, previous):
        if previous is not None and owned(previous):
            raise ValueError("onboard processes are already running; stop the recorded launch first")
        token = token or secrets.token_hex(16)
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", token):
            raise ValueError("onboard launch requires a random 32-character hex token")
        run = folder / token
        run.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        sources = source_hashes(root)
        # Preserve the exact starting source for review, without pretending a
        # later workspace edit changed an already-running Python process.
        for name in sources:
            target = run / "source" / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(root / name, target)
        record = {"schema": SCHEMA, "token": token, "project": str(root), "mode": mode,
                  "world_token": world_token,
                  "created_at": time.time(), "sources": sources, "processes": [],
                  "deployment": None if deployment is None else {"path": str(deployment),
                      "sha256": hashlib.sha256(deployment.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}}
        atomic(path, record)  # token recorded BEFORE any child exists
        atomic(run / "launch.json", record)
        env = dict(os.environ, FLYX_ONBOARD_TOKEN=token,
                   PYTHONPATH=str(root) + os.pathsep + os.environ.get("PYTHONPATH", ""))
        try:
            for row in rows:
                log_path = run / (row["name"] + ".log")
                with log_path.open("ab", buffering=0) as log:
                    child = subprocess.Popen(row["argv"], cwd=root, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                             stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
                stamp = starttime(child.pid)
                if stamp is None:
                    raise RuntimeError(row["name"] + " exited at startup; inspect " + str(log_path))
                record["processes"].append(dict(row, pid=child.pid, start=stamp, log=str(log_path)))
                atomic(path, record)
                atomic(run / "launch.json", record)
            time.sleep(0.15)
            result = view(root, record)
            if result["state"] != "running":
                raise RuntimeError("an onboard service exited; inspect the recorded logs")
            return result
        except BaseException:
            stop_owned(record)
            raise


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("start", "status", "stop"))
    parser.add_argument("--project", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=("vio", "gnss"))
    parser.add_argument("--deployment", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--token", help="exact launch ownership, for lifecycle integration")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    root = project_root(args.project)
    deployment = args.deployment
    mode = args.mode
    world_token = None
    metadata = Path("/etc/flyx/onboard.json")
    if args.command == "start" and metadata.is_file():
        info = json.loads(metadata.read_text()); deployment = deployment or Path(info["params_file"])
        if info.get("onboard_owner") != "companion":
            parser.error("the simulator has not handed estimation to this workspace")
        mode = mode or info["mode"]
        world_token = info.get("world_token")
    if args.command == "start" and os.environ.get("FLYX_LAB_ACTIVE") == "1" and not metadata.is_file():
        parser.error("this worker still owns its VIO externally; explicit workspace migration is required")
    try:
        result = (start(root, mode or "vio", deployment, args.token, world_token) if args.command == "start" else
                  stop(root, args.token) if args.command == "stop" else status(root))
    except (ValueError, OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
        parser.exit(2, "onboard: " + str(error) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
````

## File: refnav/__init__.py
````python
"""refnav - the reference flight package: pure flight logic (core.py, depth.py) behind a thin
ROS 2 node (node.py). Runs unchanged against the simulator, recorded data and hardware; the
launch files in ../launch supply topics, clocks, calibration (TF) and, in the simulator only,
lockstep acknowledgements. Graders live in ../grader and only observe."""
````

## File: refnav/core.py
````python
"""refnav.core - the reference mission's flight logic. PURE: no ROS, no clock reads, no files.

Everything arrives through calls that carry their own time, on ONE clock chosen by whoever runs
it: simulation time in the simulator and in replays of recorded data (ROS use_sim_time + /clock),
system time on hardware. The same code therefore runs against all three.

The mission: wait until PX4 has a valid position and heading, the estimator reports healthy and
the depth camera is live -> stream a hold setpoint, request Offboard and arm -> climb -> fly a
pre-planned route of legs (each leg: turn to face it, check the depth ahead, advance a carrot at a
bounded speed while the live depth shows the way clear) -> land.

Safety behaviour (each one is a test in tests/test_refnav_core.py):
* fail closed on estimator health: absent, stale or unhealthy refuses to arm; unhealthy or silent
  for health_bad_land_s in the air lands;
* no translation without OBSERVED free space: the carrot advances only while a depth frame no older
  than depth_stale_s returned depth on at least min_corridor_coverage of the rays crossing the
  corridor ahead (no return is unknown space, never free space); a blank, sparse (valid fraction
  < min_valid_frac), future-stamped, stale-on-arrival or out-of-order frame refreshes nothing; no
  usable depth for depth_lost_land_s lands;
* an obstacle closer than stop_m ahead stops the aircraft and ends the route (it lands where it
  is: route blocked; planning around obstacles is the student's job);
* PX4 leaving Offboard while airborne (a pilot or a failsafe) is never fought: the mission stops
  streaming and commanding and ends ("yielded");
* PX4 owns the landing: once AUTO_LAND is observed the mission stops streaming setpoints (PX4's
  land detector reads the trajectory_setpoint topic; a position-only stream blanks its
  commanded-descent test and the aircraft never detects touchdown);
* a landing REQUEST from outside (the interactive runtime's `land`, request_land) goes through this
  same landing: airborne it lands where it is; before arming it ends without arming; while arming it
  ends with a normal checked disarm. It never adds a controller.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from . import depth as D

NAV_OFFBOARD = 14
NAV_AUTO_LAND = 18
AIRBORNE = ("climb", "hover", "turn", "check", "go", "hold")


@dataclass
class Params:
    route: list = field(default_factory=list)   # [(forward_m, left_m)] from the takeoff point and heading
    height_m: float = 1.2
    speed_mps: float = 0.6
    lead_max_m: float = 1.0                     # the carrot never leads the aircraft by more
    yaw_rate_dps: float = 45.0
    face_tol_deg: float = 8.0
    arrive_m: float = 0.3
    hold_s: float = 1.0
    climb_tol_m: float = 0.15
    climb_rate_mps: float = 0.5
    hover_s: float = 0.0                        # hold at height_m this long after the climb (0: straight on)
    health_quiet_s: float = 3.0                 # healthy this long before arming
    health_stale_s: float = 1.0
    health_bad_land_s: float = 1.0
    depth_stale_s: float = 0.5
    depth_lost_land_s: float = 3.0
    stop_m: float = 0.9
    corridor_half_m: float = 0.6
    band_m: float = 0.4
    min_obstacle_px: int = 1200                 # an obstacle covers at least this many image pixels (~35 x 35):
                                                # a 5 cm pole does out to ~4 m, sparse stereo junk does not
    depth_stride: int = 8                       # every n-th pixel of the depth image is used
    min_valid_frac: float = 0.3                 # below this a frame is unusable (flight data: >= 0.76)
    min_corridor_coverage: float = 0.6          # of the corridor's rays must return depth (flight data: >= 0.86)
    depth_future_tol_s: float = 0.05            # a capture stamp later than now + this is refused
    depth_border_px: int = 24                   # image edge ignored (stereo matching is weakest there)
    confirm_frames: int = 2                     # an obstacle must be in this many consecutive frames to stop
    stream_lead_s: float = 1.0                  # setpoints stream this long before Offboard is requested
    wait_s: float = 300.0                       # nothing ready this long: give up without arming
    arm_wait_s: float = 30.0
    cmd_resend_s: float = 1.0
    land_timeout_s: float = 60.0


@dataclass
class Vehicle:
    """The latest PX4 reports, updated by the adapter as messages arrive."""
    pos: tuple | None = None          # NED metres (vehicle_local_position)
    heading: float | None = None      # rad
    pos_ok: bool = False              # xy_valid and z_valid and a heading (good for control, or PX4 yaw-aligned)
    q: tuple | None = None            # attitude, FRD -> NED, (w, x, y, z)
    armed: bool | None = None
    nav_state: int | None = None
    landed: bool | None = None


@dataclass
class Output:
    phase: str
    setpoint: tuple | None = None     # (n, e, d, yaw) for the trajectory setpoint
    stream: bool = False              # publish offboard_control_mode + the setpoint this tick
    commands: list = field(default_factory=list)   # "offboard" | "arm" | "land" | "disarm" (checked)
    events: list = field(default_factory=list)


class Health:
    """Estimator health from a boolean stream, failing closed: nothing heard, stale or unhealthy
    is never permission, and a gap restarts the quiet window."""

    def __init__(self, quiet_s, stale_s):
        self.quiet_s, self.stale_s = float(quiet_s), float(stale_s)
        self.last_t = self.last_ok = self.ok_since = self.bad_since = None

    def on_msg(self, t, ok):
        ok = bool(ok)
        if ok:
            if not self.last_ok or self.ok_since is None or (self.last_t is not None and t - self.last_t > self.stale_s):
                self.ok_since = t
            self.bad_since = None
        else:
            self.ok_since = None
            if self.bad_since is None:
                self.bad_since = t
        self.last_t, self.last_ok = t, ok

    def fresh(self, now):
        return self.last_t is not None and now - self.last_t <= self.stale_s

    def arm_ok(self, now):
        if self.last_t is None:
            return False, "no estimator health received"
        if not self.fresh(now):
            return False, f"estimator health stale ({now - self.last_t:.1f} s)"
        if not self.last_ok:
            return False, "estimator unhealthy"
        if now - self.ok_since < self.quiet_s:
            return False, f"estimator healthy for only {now - self.ok_since:.1f}/{self.quiet_s:.0f} s"
        return True, "ok"

    def bad_for(self, now):
        if self.last_t is None:
            return math.inf
        if not self.fresh(now):
            return now - (self.last_t + self.stale_s)
        if not self.last_ok:
            return now - self.bad_since
        return 0.0


def _wrap(a):
    return (a + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi


class Mission:
    def __init__(self, params: Params):
        self.p = params
        self.health = Health(params.health_quiet_s, params.health_stale_s)
        self.phase = "wait"
        self.why = ""
        self.sp = None
        self.home = None              # (n, e, d, heading) at the arm request
        self.targets = []             # NED (n, e) of each leg's end
        self.leg = 0
        self.legs_done = 0
        self.t_phase = None
        self.t_started = None         # the first time this mission saw (its clock): where a replay starts
        self.t_last = None
        self.t_cmd = None
        self.offboard_seen = False
        self.land_reason = None
        self.land_auto_seen = False
        self.result = None            # final: "complete" | "blocked" | "landed: <why>" | "refused: <why>" | "yielded: <why>"
        self.depth_ready_since = None # start of continuously usable depth before control requests
        self.depth_t = None           # capture stamp of the latest USABLE depth frame (depth alive)
        self.frame = None             # that frame (refnav.depth.DepthFrame) and its obstacle points
        self.depth_pts = None
        self.corr_t = None            # stamp of the latest frame that OBSERVED the current corridor
        self._judged_t = None         # the latest frame judged against the corridor (each frame once)
        self.last_coverage = None
        self.leg_start = None
        self.leg_dir = None
        self.leg_len = 0.0
        self.leg_heading = 0.0
        self.s = 0.0
        self.counts = {"depth_frames": 0, "obstacle_stops": 0, "depth_holds": 0, "unconfirmed_obstacles": 0,
                       "depth_unusable": 0, "depth_future": 0, "depth_stale": 0, "depth_out_of_order": 0,
                       "corridor_unobserved": 0}
        self.clr_hist = []            # [(depth stamp, clearance)] along the current leg, newest last
        self.last_clearance = None
        self.land_request = None      # why an outside landing request was made (request_land), until acted on
        self.depth_reject = None      # (key, detail): why the latest refused depth frame was refused
        self.last_valid_frac = None   # fraction of pixels returning depth in the latest decoded frame

    def request_land(self, why="requested"):
        """An outside request to end the flight through the mission's own landing (no second controller)."""
        if self.land_request is None:
            self.land_request = str(why) or "requested"

    def depth_refused(self, key, detail):
        """A depth frame was refused (here, or before it reached the mission: no calibration, no
        attitude, an undecodable image). The reason is what the wait reports, with its numbers."""
        self.depth_reject = (str(key), str(detail))
        # Obsolete transport packets do not contradict the newer usable stream.
        # Its existing freshness deadline still expires if current data stops.
        if key not in ("out_of_order", "stale"):
            self.depth_ready_since = None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ inputs
    def on_health(self, t, ok):
        self.health.on_msg(t, ok)

    def on_depth(self, stamp, depth_m, K, R_body_cam, t_body_cam, q_wxyz, now=None):
        """One depth frame with its own calibration; stamp = capture time on the mission clock, now =
        that clock at arrival (None: not judged for being from the future). -> True if it was usable."""
        if q_wxyz is None:
            self.depth_refused("attitude_missing", "no attitude for this depth frame")
            return False
        stamp = float(stamp)
        if now is not None and stamp > now + self.p.depth_future_tol_s:
            self.counts["depth_future"] += 1
            self.depth_refused("future", f"stamped {stamp - now:.2f} s in the future "
                                         f"(depth_future_tol_s {self.p.depth_future_tol_s:g} s)")
            return False
        if now is not None and now - stamp > self.p.depth_stale_s:
            self.counts["depth_stale"] += 1                  # too old to act on when it arrives
            self.depth_refused("stale", f"{now - stamp:.2f} s old on arrival (depth_stale_s {self.p.depth_stale_s:g} s)")
            return False
        if self.depth_t is not None and stamp <= self.depth_t:
            self.counts["depth_out_of_order"] += 1
            self.depth_refused("out_of_order", "stamped no later than the last frame used")
            return False
        f = D.DepthFrame(depth_m, K, R_body_cam, t_body_cam, D.level_rotation(q_wxyz), stride=self.p.depth_stride,
                         border_px=self.p.depth_border_px)
        self.last_valid_frac = f.valid_frac
        if f.valid_frac < self.p.min_valid_frac:
            self.counts["depth_unusable"] += 1
            self.depth_refused("too_little_depth", f"depth on {f.valid_frac:.0%} of the pixels, this mission needs "
                                                   f"{self.p.min_valid_frac:.0%} (min_valid_frac)")
            return False
        if (self.depth_ready_since is None or self.depth_t is None
                or stamp - self.depth_t > self.p.depth_stale_s):
            self.depth_ready_since = stamp
        self.frame, self.depth_t, self.depth_pts = f, stamp, f.points(0.3, 6.0)
        self.depth_reject = None                             # a refusal is only reported until a frame is used
        self.counts["depth_frames"] += 1
        return True

    def depth_fresh(self, now):
        """A usable depth frame is recent (the camera is alive), whatever it looked at."""
        return self.depth_t is not None and now - self.depth_t <= self.p.depth_stale_s

    def depth_ready_for_arm(self, now):
        """Same quiet interval as estimator health, measured in usable capture history.

        A rare good snapshot among unusable frames cannot authorize motors. This
        only gates the first control request; airborne/authority policy is unchanged.
        """
        return (self.depth_fresh(now) and self.depth_ready_since is not None
                and math.isfinite(self.p.health_quiet_s) and self.p.health_quiet_s >= 0
                and self.depth_t - self.depth_ready_since >= self.p.health_quiet_s)

    def corridor_fresh(self, now):
        """A recent frame OBSERVED the corridor of the current leg."""
        return self.corr_t is not None and now - self.corr_t <= self.p.depth_stale_s

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ step
    def _set(self, phase, now, out, why=""):
        out.events.append(f"{self.phase} -> {phase}" + (f": {why}" if why else ""))
        self.phase, self.t_phase = phase, now
        if why:
            self.why = why

    def _end(self, now, out, result):
        self.result = result
        self._set("done", now, out, result)

    def _land(self, now, out, why):
        self.land_reason = why
        self._set("land", now, out, why)

    def _resend(self, now):
        if self.t_cmd is None or now - self.t_cmd >= self.p.cmd_resend_s:
            self.t_cmd = now
            return True
        return False

    def _requalify(self, now, out, why):
        # Cancel the old priming interval and its held position. The original
        # preflight deadline remains t_started; this cannot renew its budget.
        self.sp, self.home, self.targets = None, None, []
        self._set("wait", now, out, why)

    def step(self, now, v: Vehicle) -> Output:
        p = self.p
        out = Output(self.phase)
        dt = 0.0 if self.t_last is None else min(max(now - self.t_last, 0.0), 0.25)
        self.t_last = now
        if self.t_phase is None:
            self.t_phase = now
        if self.t_started is None:
            self.t_started = now
        if self.phase == "done":
            return out

        if self.phase in ("wait", "arm") and self.t_cmd is None:
            if v.armed is True:
                self._end(now, out, "yielded: vehicle armed before this mission requested control")
            elif now - self.t_started > p.wait_s:
                self._end(now, out, f"refused: {self.why or 'not ready'} after {p.wait_s:.0f} s")
            elif self.phase == "arm" and v.armed is None:
                self._requalify(now, out, "waiting for an explicit disarmed PX4 report")

        # ---- airborne supervision, before anything else may command -------------------
        if self.phase in AIRBORNE or (self.phase == "land" and not self.land_auto_seen):
            # only the mission's OWN landing may put PX4 in AUTO_LAND; anywhere else that is PX4 (a
            # failsafe) or a pilot taking over, and streaming on would blank PX4's land detector
            allowed = (NAV_OFFBOARD, NAV_AUTO_LAND) if self.phase == "land" else (NAV_OFFBOARD,)
            if self.offboard_seen and v.nav_state is not None and v.nav_state not in allowed:
                self._end(now, out, f"yielded: PX4 left Offboard (nav_state {v.nav_state}): a pilot or a failsafe has it")
                out.phase = self.phase
                return out
        if self.land_request is not None and self.phase in ("wait", "arm") + AIRBORNE:
            why = f"landing requested: {self.land_request}"
            if self.phase == "wait":
                self._end(now, out, f"refused: {why} before arming")
            elif self.phase == "arm":
                if v.armed:
                    out.commands.append("disarm")          # a normal, checked disarm: on the ground, never forced
                self._end(now, out, f"refused: {why} while arming")
            else:
                self._land(now, out, why)
            self.land_request = None
            out.phase = self.phase
        if self.phase in AIRBORNE:
            bad = self.health.bad_for(now)
            if bad > p.health_bad_land_s:
                self._land(now, out, f"estimator unhealthy or silent for {bad:.1f} s")
            elif not v.pos_ok or v.pos is None:
                self._land(now, out, "PX4 position or heading invalid")
            elif self.depth_t is None or now - self.depth_t > p.depth_lost_land_s:
                self._land(now, out, f"depth silent for more than {p.depth_lost_land_s:.0f} s")

        ph = self.phase
        if ph == "wait":
            ok, why = self.health.arm_ok(now)
            if now - self.t_started > p.wait_s:
                self._end(now, out, f"refused: {self.why or 'not ready'} after {p.wait_s:.0f} s")
            elif v.armed is not False:
                self.why = "waiting for an explicit disarmed PX4 report"
            elif not v.pos_ok or v.pos is None or v.heading is None:
                self.why = "waiting for PX4 position and heading"
            elif not ok:
                self.why = why
            elif not self.depth_fresh(now):
                self.why = "waiting for live depth: " + (
                    f"the latest frame was refused: {self.depth_reject[1]}" if self.depth_reject else
                    "no depth frame has arrived" if self.depth_t is None else
                    f"the latest usable frame is {now - self.depth_t:.1f} s old")
            elif not self.depth_ready_for_arm(now):
                self.why = f"waiting for {p.health_quiet_s:g} s of continuously usable depth"
            else:
                n, e, d = v.pos
                self.home = (n, e, d, v.heading)
                self.sp = [n, e, d, v.heading]
                c, s = math.cos(v.heading), math.sin(v.heading)
                self.targets = [(n + f * c + l * s, e + f * s - l * c) for f, l in p.route]
                self._set("arm", now, out)
        elif ph == "arm":
            ok, why = self.health.arm_ok(now)
            if not ok:
                if self.t_cmd is None and v.armed is False:
                    self._requalify(now, out, f"{why}; requalifying before any control request")
                else:
                    self._end(now, out, f"refused: {why} before arming")
            elif self.t_cmd is None and not self.depth_ready_for_arm(now):
                if v.armed is False:
                    self._requalify(now, out, "depth not continuously usable; requalifying before any control request")
                else:
                    self._end(now, out, "yielded: depth lost before this mission requested control")
            elif now - self.t_phase > p.arm_wait_s:
                if v.armed:
                    out.commands.append("disarm")          # a normal, checked disarm: on the ground, never forced
                self._end(now, out, f"refused: not armed in Offboard after {p.arm_wait_s:.0f} s")
            elif v.armed and v.nav_state == NAV_OFFBOARD:
                self.offboard_seen = True
                self._set("climb", now, out)
            elif now - self.t_phase >= p.stream_lead_s and self._resend(now):
                out.commands += ["offboard", "arm"]
        elif ph == "climb":
            target = self.home[2] - p.height_m
            self.sp[2] = max(target, self.sp[2] - p.climb_rate_mps * dt)
            if self.sp[2] <= target + 1e-9 and abs(v.pos[2] - target) < p.climb_tol_m:
                if p.hover_s > 0:
                    self._set("hover", now, out, f"holding {p.hover_s:.0f} s at {p.height_m:.1f} m")
                else:
                    self._next_leg(now, out, v)
        elif ph == "hover":
            if now - self.t_phase >= p.hover_s:
                self._next_leg(now, out, v)
        elif ph == "turn":
            err = _wrap(self.leg_heading - self.sp[3])
            step = math.radians(p.yaw_rate_dps) * dt
            self.sp[3] = _wrap(self.sp[3] + max(-step, min(step, err)))
            if abs(err) < 1e-3 and abs(_wrap(self.leg_heading - v.heading)) < math.radians(p.face_tol_deg):
                self._set("check", now, out)
        elif ph == "check":
            # a depth frame captured AFTER the turn ended looks along this leg
            if self.depth_t is not None and self.depth_t >= self.t_phase and self.depth_fresh(now):
                if self.clr_hist and self.clr_hist[0][0] < self.t_phase:
                    self.clr_hist, self.corr_t = [], None    # frames from before the turn ended look elsewhere
                clr = self._clearance(v)                     # None: not enough observed frames yet, wait
                if clr is not None and self.corridor_fresh(now):
                    self.last_clearance = clr
                    if clr < p.stop_m:
                        self.counts["obstacle_stops"] += 1
                        self._land(now, out, f"route blocked: obstacle {clr:.2f} m ahead at leg {self.leg + 1}")
                    else:
                        self.s = 0.0
                        self._set("go", now, out)
        elif ph == "go":
            self._go(now, dt, out, v)
        elif ph == "hold":
            if now - self.t_phase >= p.hold_s:
                self.legs_done += 1
                self.leg += 1
                self._next_leg(now, out, v)

        if self.phase == "land":
            if v.nav_state == NAV_AUTO_LAND:
                self.land_auto_seen = True
            if not self.land_auto_seen and self._resend(now):
                out.commands.append("land")
            if self.land_auto_seen and v.armed is False:
                why = self.land_reason or ""
                self._end(now, out, "complete" if why == "route complete" else f"landed: {why}")
            elif now - self.t_phase > p.land_timeout_s:
                self._end(now, out, f"landed: {self.land_reason}; landing not confirmed within {p.land_timeout_s:.0f} s")

        out.phase = self.phase
        out.setpoint = tuple(self.sp) if self.sp is not None else None
        # PX4 owns the landing once AUTO_LAND is seen: nothing streams from then on
        out.stream = self.phase in ("arm",) + AIRBORNE or (self.phase == "land" and not self.land_auto_seen)
        return out

    def _next_leg(self, now, out, v):
        if self.leg >= len(self.targets):
            self._land(now, out, "route complete")
            return
        start = (self.sp[0], self.sp[1])
        tn, te = self.targets[self.leg]
        dn, de = tn - start[0], te - start[1]
        self.leg_len = math.hypot(dn, de)
        self.leg_start = start
        self.leg_dir = (dn / self.leg_len, de / self.leg_len) if self.leg_len > 1e-6 else (1.0, 0.0)
        self.leg_heading = math.atan2(de, dn) if self.leg_len > 1e-6 else self.sp[3]
        self.clr_hist, self.corr_t = [], None
        self._set("turn", now, out, f"leg {self.leg + 1}/{len(self.targets)}")

    def _clearance(self, v):
        """Clearance along the leg CONFIRMED by the last confirm_frames frames that OBSERVED the
        corridor: the largest of their clearances, so an obstacle counts only when every one of
        those frames shows it (a stereo false match lasts a frame; a wall does not go away). A frame
        whose rays through the corridor (at stop_m + lead_max_m ahead) mostly returned nothing has
        observed nothing there and is not evidence of free space. None = unknown (do not move)."""
        p = self.p
        bearing = _wrap(self.leg_heading - v.heading)        # positive = to the right (NED yaw)
        if self.frame is not None and self._judged_t != self.depth_t:
            self._judged_t = self.depth_t
            cov, _ = self.frame.corridor_coverage(bearing, p.corridor_half_m, p.band_m, p.stop_m + p.lead_max_m)
            self.last_coverage = cov
            if cov >= p.min_corridor_coverage:
                hits = max(3, round(p.min_obstacle_px / p.depth_stride ** 2))
                c = D.clearance(self.depth_pts, bearing, p.corridor_half_m, p.band_m, hits)
                self.clr_hist = (self.clr_hist + [(self.depth_t, c)])[-max(1, p.confirm_frames):]
                self.corr_t = self.depth_t
            else:
                self.counts["corridor_unobserved"] += 1
        if len(self.clr_hist) < self.p.confirm_frames:
            return None
        confirmed = max(c for _, c in self.clr_hist)
        if min(c for _, c in self.clr_hist) < self.p.stop_m <= confirmed:
            self.counts["unconfirmed_obstacles"] += 1
        return confirmed

    def _go(self, now, dt, out, v):
        p = self.p
        n0, e0 = self.leg_start
        un, ue = self.leg_dir
        proj = (v.pos[0] - n0) * un + (v.pos[1] - e0) * ue
        clr = self._clearance(v) if self.depth_fresh(now) else None
        if clr is not None and not self.corridor_fresh(now):
            clr = None                                       # the latest evidence of this corridor is too old
        if clr is not None:
            self.last_clearance = clr
            if clr < p.stop_m:
                # stop where the aircraft is (not where the carrot was)
                self.sp[0], self.sp[1] = v.pos[0], v.pos[1]
                self.counts["obstacle_stops"] += 1
                self._land(now, out, f"route blocked: obstacle {clr:.2f} m ahead on leg {self.leg + 1}")
                return
            self.s = min(self.s + p.speed_mps * dt, self.leg_len, max(proj, 0.0) + p.lead_max_m)
        else:
            self.counts["depth_holds"] += 1                  # no live evidence: the carrot waits
        self.sp[0], self.sp[1] = n0 + un * self.s, e0 + ue * self.s
        tn, te = self.targets[self.leg]
        if self.s >= self.leg_len - 1e-6 and math.hypot(v.pos[0] - tn, v.pos[1] - te) < p.arrive_m:
            self._set("hold", now, out, f"arrived leg {self.leg + 1}")

    def status(self, now):
        return {"phase": self.phase, "why": self.why, "result": self.result, "started_t": self.t_started, "leg": self.leg,
                "legs": len(self.targets), "legs_done": self.legs_done, "home": self.home,
                "targets": [list(t) for t in self.targets], "setpoint": list(self.sp) if self.sp else None,
                "clearance_m": (None if self.last_clearance is None or math.isinf(self.last_clearance)
                                else round(self.last_clearance, 2)),
                "depth_age_s": None if self.depth_t is None else round(now - self.depth_t, 3),
                "corridor_age_s": None if self.corr_t is None else round(now - self.corr_t, 3),
                "corridor_coverage": None if self.last_coverage is None else round(self.last_coverage, 2),
                "depth_valid_frac": None if self.last_valid_frac is None else round(self.last_valid_frac, 3),
                "depth_reject": None if self.depth_reject is None else self.depth_reject[1],
                "health_bad_s": (None if math.isinf(self.health.bad_for(now)) else round(self.health.bad_for(now), 2)),
                **self.counts}
````

## File: refnav/depth.py
````python
"""Forward clearance from one depth frame. PURE (numpy only).

The frame arrives with its own calibration: the pinhole intrinsics from CameraInfo and the
camera's pose on the body from TF (base_link <- camera optical frame, REP-103: optical x right,
y down, z forward; body x forward, y left, z up). The vehicle attitude levels the points, so
"ahead" and "at flight height" mean the same thing while the airframe is tilted.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

import numpy as np

# body FLU -> body FRD (PX4's body frame)
_FLU_TO_FRD = np.diag([1.0, -1.0, -1.0])


def quat_to_mat(w, x, y, z):
    return np.array([
        [1 - 2 * (y * y + z * z), 2 * (x * y - z * w), 2 * (x * z + y * w)],
        [2 * (x * y + z * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + z * z), 2 * (y * z - x * w)],
        [2 * (x * z - y * w), 2 * (y * z + x * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + y * y)],
    ])


def level_rotation(q_wxyz):
    """Rotation taking body-FLU vectors into the LEVEL heading frame (x forward horizontal,
    y right horizontal, z down), i.e. PX4's attitude with its yaw removed. q = PX4's
    vehicle_attitude quaternion (FRD body -> NED), w first."""
    R = quat_to_mat(*q_wxyz)                                   # NED <- FRD
    yaw = math.atan2(R[1, 0], R[0, 0])
    c, s = math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw)
    Rz_inv = np.array([[c, s, 0.0], [-s, c, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]])
    return Rz_inv @ R @ _FLU_TO_FRD


def decode_depth(encoding, height, width, step, data):
    """sensor_msgs/Image depth -> float32 metres (NaN = no return). 32FC1 is metres,
    16UC1 is millimetres (0 = invalid); anything else raises ValueError."""
    enc = encoding.lower()
    if enc == "32fc1":
        a = np.frombuffer(data, np.float32).reshape(height, step // 4)[:, :width].astype(np.float32)
        a = a.copy()
        a[~np.isfinite(a) | (a <= 0.0)] = np.nan
        return a
    if enc in ("16uc1", "mono16"):
        a = np.frombuffer(data, np.uint16).reshape(height, step // 2)[:, :width].astype(np.float32) * 1e-3
        a[a <= 0.0] = np.nan
        return a
    raise ValueError(f"unsupported depth encoding {encoding!r} (need 32FC1 metres or 16UC1 millimetres)")


class DepthFrame:
    """One depth frame, sampled every `stride` pixels inside a `border_px` margin, in the LEVEL
    heading frame (forward, right, down) relative to the body origin. Keeps, per sampled pixel, its
    ray and whether the camera returned ANY depth for it - so the frame can say what it observed
    (a return, near or far) apart from what it did not (no return: unknown, never free space)."""

    def __init__(self, depth_m, K, R_body_cam, t_body_cam, R_level_body, stride=8, border_px=0):
        fx, fy, cx, cy = K
        d = np.asarray(depth_m, np.float32)
        h, w = d.shape
        b = int(border_px)
        vs, us = np.mgrid[b:h - b:stride, b:w - b:stride] if b > 0 else np.mgrid[0:h:stride, 0:w:stride]
        z = d[vs, us].ravel()
        u, v = us.ravel().astype(np.float32), vs.ravel().astype(np.float32)
        rays_cam = np.stack([(u - cx) / fx, (v - cy) / fy, np.ones_like(u)], axis=1)    # optical z = 1
        R = np.asarray(R_level_body) @ np.asarray(R_body_cam)
        self.dirs = rays_cam @ R.T                     # a point at optical depth z is origin + z * dir
        self.origin = np.asarray(R_level_body) @ np.asarray(t_body_cam, float)
        self.z = z
        self.valid = np.isfinite(z) & (z > 0.0)
        self.valid_frac = float(self.valid.mean()) if z.size else 0.0

    def points(self, rmin=0.3, rmax=6.0):
        sel = self.valid & (self.z > rmin) & (self.z < rmax)
        return self.origin + self.dirs[sel] * self.z[sel, None]

    def corridor_coverage(self, bearing_rad, half_width_m, band_m, at_m):
        """Fraction of the rays that cross the corridor's cross-section at at_m ahead (along the
        bearing, within +-half_width_m and +-band_m of the body height) that returned depth.
        0.0 when no ray of this camera crosses it (the corridor is out of view)."""
        c, s = math.cos(bearing_rad), math.sin(bearing_rad)
        along_dir = self.dirs[:, 0] * c + self.dirs[:, 1] * s
        ok = along_dir > 1e-6
        t = np.where(ok, (at_m - (self.origin[0] * c + self.origin[1] * s)) / np.where(ok, along_dir, 1.0), -1.0)
        p = self.origin + self.dirs * t[:, None]
        across = -p[:, 0] * s + p[:, 1] * c
        window = ok & (t > 0) & (np.abs(across) < half_width_m) & (np.abs(p[:, 2]) < band_m)
        n = int(window.sum())
        return (float(self.valid[window].mean()) if n else 0.0), n


def level_points(depth_m, K, R_body_cam, t_body_cam, R_level_body, stride=8, rmin=0.3, rmax=6.0, border_px=0):
    """Depth image -> (N,3) points in the level heading frame relative to the body origin:
    columns (forward, right, down) in metres. K = (fx, fy, cx, cy). border_px: ignore that many
    pixels at every image edge, where a stereo matcher has the least support (a real OAK-D and
    the simulator's SGBM both produce false near matches along the top rows)."""
    fx, fy, cx, cy = K
````
